about: Background-check wording and its usual names, which no request to any model route (and no copy shared with other AI apps) may carry (owner decision 2026-11-14: never sent to any model, even as placeholders; review Q H2). The one list, read by the page (core/src/harness/background-wording.ts, through core/src/ask.ts), compiled into the native check (core/native-auth/src/background.rs) and copied byte for byte to ozzie.church (web/src/lib/hosted/fixed, scripts/sync-fixed.mjs). Never sent itself. On the oracle corpus it refuses everything the page regex of v0.1.0 refused (core/test/harness/background-wording-oracle.test.ts). ozzies_own: Ozzie's own fixed sentences that a tool result carries as a whole string; a text that is exactly one of them, and nothing else, holds no wording (a test finds each in what Ozzie sends). newer_unicode: characters the native Unicode data knows and the page's JavaScript engine may not (hex code points); both sides treat them the same way before anything else, so their data never decides. Matching: a text holds wording when any of three foldings does. Each maps newer_unicode, then compatibility forms (NFKC), then format, private-use and default-ignorable characters and the blank braille pattern (join: deleted, so a zero-width character inside a word hides nothing; split: a word break, so an invisible blank between words hides nothing; v010: deleted when v0.1.0 deleted them (format and private-use characters, the combining grapheme joiner, variation selectors and tags) and a word break otherwise, as v0.1.0 read them), then accents, then lower case. Words are runs of a-z and 0-9; every other character separates them. A phrase is words in a row, separated by single spaces; in each slot one of the alternatives split on |, exactly, or as a prefix when it ends in *. There are no exceptions by neighbouring words. Shared vectors: core/test/harness/background-wording-vectors.json.
ozzies_own: Rooms, follow-ups and group meetings: this check is out of date, so they aren't shown.
